app.name: Askorus
app.notOfficial: Not an official product of any AI company.
home.emptyHint: Run askorus-agent pair on your PC and scan the QR code with this app.
error.network: Can't reach the PC. Check that Tailscale is on on this phone and that the PC is awake with the agent running.
error.unauthorized: This phone is no longer paired with the PC. Pair again.
error.wrong_account: This Tailscale account is not the PC owner's.
error.owner_unknown: The PC doesn't know its owner's Tailscale account.
error.bad_host: The PC address is not on the agent's allowed list.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 10 minutes.
error.pair_closed: No pairing window is open on the PC. Run pair on the PC again.
error.pair_busy: Another device is pairing right now.
error.pair_timeout: No answer on the PC within 2 minutes.
error.pair_unknown: The pairing request ended or expired. Run pair on the PC again.
error.session_busy: Something else is running on this session.
error.session_in_terminal: This session is open in a terminal on the PC.
error.session_not_background: Only background sessions can be stopped.
error.session_state_unknown: The PC couldn't read the session state.
error.workspace_not_trusted: This folder isn't trusted on the PC yet. Run claude in that folder once and accept the trust prompt.
error.remote_link_timeout: The session started but no remote link appeared.
error.launch_failed: Starting claude on the PC failed.
error.folder_not_found: This folder isn't on the allowed list.
error.agent_unavailable: Claude Code wasn't found on the PC.
error.service_elevated: The Claude background service runs as administrator. In an administrator terminal on the PC, run: claude daemon stop --any
error.not_a_git_repository: Only available for folders that are git repositories.
error.job_not_found: The task ended or the agent restarted.
error.too_many_jobs: The PC is still opening or starting other sessions. Try again in a moment.
pair.title: Pair with a PC
pair.tailscaleTitle: Turn on Tailscale on this phone
pair.tailscaleBody: Sign in with the same Tailscale account as the PC and keep it connected. A phone runs one VPN at a time, so turn other VPNs off.
pair.scanHint: Fit the QR code on the PC screen inside the frame.
pair.badQR: This is not an Askorus pairing QR code.
pair.badLink: Not a pairing link. Paste the whole link shown on the PC.
pair.confirmWarn: Pair only if this address matches the one on your own PC's screen. Do not pair from a link or QR code someone sent you. The PC you pair with receives your questions.
pair.confirmBody: When you tap Pair, your PC asks whether to allow this phone.
pair.deviceName: Name of this phone on the PC
pair.waitingTitle: Waiting for the PC to allow it
pair.waitingBody: Press y in the terminal on the PC. Waiting up to 2 minutes.
pair.notTailnet: This address could not be confirmed as a PC inside your Tailscale network, so no pairing request was sent. Check that Tailscale is on on this phone, with the same account as the PC. If the link or QR code came from someone else, do not use it.
pair.noAddress: The PC's address could not be found, so no pairing request was sent. Check that Tailscale is on on this phone, with the same account as the PC, and that the PC is on.
pair.cameraWhy: The camera is needed to scan the QR code on the PC screen.
pair.noScanner: This build cannot scan QR codes. Go back and paste the link shown on the PC instead.
sessions.agentsUnavailable: The PC couldn't read which sessions are running, so states may show as Unknown.
sessions.gone: This PC is no longer in the list.
sheet.opening: Starting the session on the PC… usually under 15 seconds.
sheet.hint.use_rc_in_terminal: This session is open in a terminal on the PC. Type /rc in that terminal to continue it in the Claude app.
sheet.hint.server_session: A folder server runs this session. Open it from the PC list in the Claude app.
sheet.stopped: Stopped. Opening it again resumes it.
sheet.removeBody: If it is running it stops, and it is hidden from this list. The conversation file stays on the PC.
sheet.attachHint: Paste this into a terminal on the PC.
error.session_folder_missing: This session's folder was deleted from the PC, so it can't be opened.
sheet.folderMissing: This session's folder was deleted from the PC, so it can't be opened. Remove it to clear it from the list.
new.title: New session
new.noFolders: No folders to pick. Folders you have used with Claude Code on the PC show up here, or add one on the PC with askorus-agent folders add <folder>.
new.name: Name
new.namePlaceholder: Leave empty for the folder name and time
new.start: Start and open in the Claude app
new.starting: Starting a new session on the PC… usually under 15 seconds.
folders.title: Folders
folders.intro: A folder kept open stays open on the PC, so you can start new sessions in it right from the PC list in the Claude app.
folders.notSupported: This PC's agent doesn't support keeping folders open.
folders.state.untrusted: This folder isn't trusted on the PC yet. Run claude in it once and accept the trust prompt.
folders.state.external: A server started separately on the PC runs here, so it is left alone.
folders.offNote: Turning a folder off doesn't remove it from the Claude app right away; it shows as offline. A new session started there waits, and begins only when you turn the folder back on here within about 4 hours. After about 4 hours the folder drops out of the Claude app's list, and turning it on connects afresh, so the waiting session never starts.
folders.justOff: It is still listed in the Claude app. A session started there now begins when you turn the folder back on here within about 4 hours.
settings.title: Settings
settings.renameHint: The name is kept on this phone only. The PC itself is not renamed.
settings.unpairBody: This phone's token is deleted here and on the PC. To use it again, pair again.
settings.leftOnPC: Couldn't reach the PC, so the device may still be listed there. Remove it on the PC with askorus-agent devices revoke {id}.
diag.agentOld: Agent {version} is out of date. Update it on the PC.
diag.askAgentMissing: {name}: not on this PC (left out of asks)
diag.askAgentBroken: {name}: on the PC but not working (left out of asks). Run askorus-agent check on the PC.
notice.codex_script_only: Codex is installed only as an npm script (codex.cmd). Set codexPath in agent.json to the real codex.exe.
notice.opencode_script_only: OpenCode is installed only as an npm script (opencode.cmd). Set opencodePath in agent.json to the real opencode.exe.
notice.codex_version_failed: Couldn't read the Codex version on the PC. Check that it is signed in.
notice.opencode_version_failed: Couldn't read the OpenCode version on the PC.
notice.claude_not_found: Claude Code wasn't found on the PC.
notice.claude_version_failed: Couldn't read the Claude Code version on the PC. Check that it is signed in.
notice.claude_remote_control_disabled_en: An environment variable on the PC turns Remote Control off.
notice.claude_service_elevated: The Claude background service runs as administrator. In an administrator terminal on the PC, run: claude daemon stop --any
folders.recentHint: Turning one on saves it to the allowed list on the PC and keeps it open.
reach.agent_down: The PC is on, but the agent is not running
reach.unpaired: This phone is no longer paired with the PC
reach.wrong_account: This Tailscale account is not the PC owner's
reach.other: The PC couldn't handle the request
reach.check.phone: Check that Tailscale is on and connected on this phone (turn other VPNs off).
reach.check.pc: Check that the PC is on and awake, with Tailscale running there.
reach.check.agent: Start the agent on the PC with askorus-agent start. To start it at logon: askorus-agent autostart on.
reach.check.agentServe: Start the agent on the PC: run askorus-agent serve in a terminal there and leave it open.
reach.check.account: Sign in to Tailscale on this phone with the same account as the PC.
ask.noPC: Your PC's AIs answer the questions.
ask.noPCHint: Pair a PC first. Whichever of Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode is on it answers.
example.title: Example
example.banner: This is an example. The answers are real: they were received with this app on {date}.
example.pairHint: Pair a PC to ask your own questions.
ask.oldAgent: The agent on this PC does not know asks yet. Update it on the PC.
ask.noAI: No AI on this PC can answer right now. See the connection check in Settings.
ask.intro: One question goes to every AI turned on, at once.
report.title: Report an AI answer
report.note: The app sends nothing by itself. Your mail app opens with the report written, and you can change it before you send it.
report.withText: Include the question and the answer
report.withTextOff: Without them the mail says only what kind of problem it is and which AI wrote the answer.
report.sendInMail: The report is sent when you press Send in your mail app.
report.noMail: No mail app could be opened. Copy the report and send it to {address}.
report.mail.subject: [Askorus report] {category}
report.mail.question: --- Question ---
ask.extras.note: Added at the end of the answer, so the comparison and the combined answer leave it out.
ask.opening: Starting this conversation on the PC… usually under 15 seconds.
ask.error.bad_model: The AI does not know this model. Change it in the AI picker.
ask.error.session_not_found: The PC could not find this conversation. Ask it as a new question.
ask.error.session_busy: This conversation is still answering, or it is open as a remote session on the PC.
ask.error.agent_unavailable: The PC could not find this AI.
ask.error.agent_cannot_ask: This AI cannot answer on this PC right now.
ask.error.too_many_runs: The PC is answering other questions. Ask again in a moment.
ask.error.ask_folder_unavailable: The PC could not make its ask folder.
ask.error.internal: Something went wrong on the PC.
ask.error.workspace_not_trusted: To carry this on in the Claude app, trust the ask folder on the PC once: in a PC terminal, go to {folder}, run claude and allow trust.
compare.oneAnswer: Only one AI answered, so there is nothing to compare.
compare.error.judge_failed: The judging AI reported an error.
compare.error.judge_timeout: The judging did not finish in time.
compare.error.judge_bad_output: The judging AI's reply could not be read, also when asked again.
compare.error.judge_used_tool: The judging AI reached for a tool, so its judgment was thrown away.
compare.error.bad_model: The judge model could not be used: unknown, or it answered with another company's model.
compare.error.agent_unavailable: That judging AI can no longer judge on this PC.
compare.error.no_judge: No AI could judge: it takes an AI of another company that did not write the answers.
compare.error.need_two_answers: Comparing needs at least two answers.
compare.error.too_many_comparisons: The PC is still comparing other answers. Tap Compare in a moment.
compare.error.comparison_not_found: The PC no longer has this comparison: it ended over a day ago, or the agent restarted. Compare again sends the answers for a new one.
compare.error.bad_compare: The PC did not take the comparison request. Update the app or the agent.
compare.error.bad_request: The PC refused the comparison request: it is too long or not as expected.
compare.error.internal: Something went wrong on the PC while comparing.
settings.synthHint: Uses one AI once more per question (the question's tier model). That AI's company receives the question and every answer.
compare.synth.title: Combined answer
compare.synth.mayErr: An AI wrote this combined answer, so it can be wrong.
compare.synth.cost: This uses one of the PC's AIs {n} more time.
compare.synth.error.judge_failed: The writing AI reported an error.
compare.synth.error.judge_timeout: The combined answer did not finish in time.
compare.synth.error.judge_bad_output: The writing AI's reply could not be read, also when asked again.
compare.synth.error.judge_used_tool: The writing AI reached for a tool, so its text was thrown away.
compare.synth.error.bad_model: The writing model could not be used: unknown, or it answered with another company's model.
compare.synth.error.agent_unavailable: The writing AI can no longer write on this PC.
compare.synth.error.no_judge: No AI could write it: it takes an AI that got this question and can write combined answers on this PC.
compare.synth.error.internal: Something went wrong on the PC while writing the combined answer.
drawer.removeBody: It is deleted from this phone only. Each AI's own record on the PC stays.
ask.emptyTitle: What would you like to ask?
ask.pickAIsNone: No AI is on to answer. Pick
ask.ownPickHint: Answers with this model and effort at every tier.
ask.pcSwitched: Switched to the PC this conversation was asked on: {name}
ask.orphan: The PC this conversation was asked on is no longer paired, so it can only be read. Pair with that PC again to carry it on.
ask.away: This conversation was asked on another PC: {name}. Switch to it to carry it on.
ask.sendWait: You can send once every answer is in.
ask.queued: Waiting: it goes once the question before it is done.
ask.notSent: Not sent: you left before the question before it was done.
ask.error.run_not_found: The PC no longer has this answer: it ended over a day ago, or the agent restarted.
ask.goingOn: The question before is still being answered and is kept in the history.
ask.moderatorRowHint: {name} · reads the conversation and answers alone (searching the web when it helps)
compare.title: Comparison
sheet.copyAttach: Copy the command to continue on the PC
settings.synthAgentLong: Moderator AI (refines questions, writes the combined answer)
settings.moderatorModelHint: Writes the combined answer and leads debates with this model and effort at every tier.
settings.moderatorModelNoPC: You can pick it once the PC with this AI is connected.
settings.refineHint: With refining on, the moderator AI reads each question before the AIs answer and adds an answer format for its kind after it. It uses the moderator AI once more per question (its quick model), and answers start about 5 seconds later. The moderator AI's company receives the question once more.
ask.refine.title: Answer format sent
ask.refine.noTemplate: No format was added for this kind.
ask.refine.how: Your question went as written, with this format added after it, to every AI.
settings.historyClearBody: Deletes every conversation kept on this phone ({n}). Each AI's own record on the PC stays.
pair.intro: Run one command on the PC and scan the QR it shows; the PC then asks whether to allow this phone.
pair.step1: Run this in a terminal on the PC
pair.step2: Scan the QR on the PC
pair.tailscaleNote: The phone and the PC need the same Tailscale account turned on
pair.installNote: First time? Install the agent on the PC first
pair.installTitle: Install the agent on the PC
pair.installBody: On the PC, open PowerShell (a normal window, not as administrator) and run this line. It installs and sets up the agent step by step, then shows a QR code: scan it here.
pair.installWindows: Windows only for now. Guide and source: github.com/heeo-dev/askorus
app.tagline: Many AI answers, debated into a better one.
licenses.title: Open-source licenses
licenses.intro: The open-source software Askorus is built with. Tap an item to read its license.
licenses.kind.npm: {n} packages the app is built with
licenses.noText: No license text is included for this item. It is under the license named above.
ask.willSynth: Once every answer is in, the moderator AI writes a combined answer.
ask.introModerator: Once the answers are in, the moderator AI reads them all and writes a combined answer. Its company receives the question and every answer.
settings.synthAutoMod: Write a combined answer once the answers are in
debate.cost: Uses the AIs about {n} more times · 2–3 min
debate.notice.title: Before the debate
debate.notice.body: In a debate, the company of every AI that answered gets the other AIs' answers and turns. Now only the company of the AI that writes the combined answer gets all the answers. Nothing goes to an AI that was not asked.
debate.title: Debate · {n} points
debate.planning: The moderator is picking what to debate…
debate.none: The AIs don't differ on anything worth a debate
debate.writing: The moderator is writing the answer after the debate…
debate.stopped: The debate was stopped. No answer after it was written.
debate.lead: The AIs read each other's answers and debate where they differ.
debate.error.too_many_debates: Another debate is running on the PC. Try again when it is over.
debate.error.debate_not_found: The debate is gone from the PC (it ended over a day ago, or the agent restarted).
debate.error.judge_bad_output: The moderator's reply was not in the debate's format, also when asked again.
debate.error.judge_timeout: The debate went over its time limit.
debate.error.no_judge: None of the AIs that answered may moderate the debate.
debate.error.bad_model: The moderator answered with a model of another company than planned.
settings.carryRecordHint: A follow-up also sends what was concluded so far (what debates settled and the last final answer) to the AIs that answer and to the moderator, so they build on it instead of starting over. Off sends the question only.
ask.queuedDebate: Waiting: it goes with the debate's conclusions once the debate ends.
ask.queuedSynth: Waiting: it goes with the combined answer once it is written.
ask.record.notice.title: Earlier conclusions go along
ask.record.notice.body: A follow-up sends what was concluded so far (a combined answer that includes other AIs' answers) to every AI that answers. Each AI's company receives it. You can turn this off in Settings › Moderator.
ask.record.title: Earlier conclusions sent
ask.record.last: The last final answer went along too.
ask.record.how: The AIs that answer and the moderator that writes the combined answer get these as data and use them only where this question needs them. New conditions in the question win.
